items.description: While many API clients include basic assertion capabilities, the tools in this section are specifically designed for automating API tests, often integrating into CI/CD pipelines. They typically treat tests as code or structured data, enabling complex scenarios, data-driven testing, comprehensive reporting, and robust validation. Some popular commercial tools often mentioned in this context include Katalon Studio, SoapUI, TestSigma, Assertible, ReadyAPI, and Apigee (though Apigee is more an API management platform), while JMeter is a powerful open-source tool focused on load testing but usable for functional API tests. The following are primarily open-source frameworks focused on functional and integration API testing.
